currentUserGoal: Use the weekly-reset runway to keep pushing the redesign toward a more readable and testable core loop.
changesMade: Converted Scourge Sense from a locked placeholder into a real permanent Memory node.
Added scourgeSense to PermanentUpgradeId, PERMANENT_UPGRADE_DEFINITIONS, permanent memory normalization, and PermanentUpgradeEffects.
Scourge Sense costs 20 permanent GT and forecasts the next wound pressure target; it does not change drain, wound timing, rewards, or dormancy math.
Updated the meta tree to show four functional nodes: Soft Touch, Deeper Roots, Tiny Sprinkler, and Scourge Sense.
Added a gold forecast halo to root views and tied it to the Scourge Sense target.

When Scourge Sense is owned, wound pressure warning starts at 42% instead of the baseline 72%, picks a valid active unwounded root, marks it, and passes that same root as the preferred wound target when pressure opens a wound.
Added HUD, prompt, advisor, feed, float-text, and browser-debug feedback for Scourge Sense forecasts.
Exposed Scourge Sense through the DOM agent layer as redesign-memory-scourgeSense, plus readable state lines for ownership, wound pressure, target root, and warning visibility.
Updated docs/CORE_MECHANICS_REDESIGN.md and docs/CORE_MECHANICS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md to describe the implemented Scourge Sense slice.
verification: npm run test passed with 2 files and 26 tests.
npm run build passed after the Scourge Sense changes.
npm run check passed after docs and code updates: ESLint passed, Vitest passed with 2 files and 26 tests, TypeScript compiled, and Vite built successfully.
